# Ordered pair transfer with a key consumer

Map<K,V> and TreeMap<K,V> retain the same ordered method slots beside a complete
Comparator<? super K>. The provider invokes the original comparator, observes
its mutations in later field reads and map writes, invokes a separate action,
and returns an opaque result. Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice for
source and SDK providers, compiling all output and auditing every original entry
and metadata. Null/raw arguments, exact callback inputs and results, partial
writes, returned identity, callee/caller casts and failures remain observable.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof.
Only authored fixtures execute.
